item.title: Holy Tuesday - One Radio™
item.description: Holy Tuesday carries a quiet urgency.Jesus speaks in parables—of servants, talents, and ten virgins waiting in the night. Some were ready. Others were not. The difference wasn’t knowledge—it was preparation.

item.description: When Grace Meets Betrayal Key Verse:“Then one of the Twelve—the one called Judas Iscariot—went to the chief priests.” — Matthew 26:14 (NIV) Scripture References:Matthew 26:14–16, Luke 22:1–6, Psalm 41:9 Devotional:Holy Wednesday is often called the day of betrayal. item.title: Maundy Thursday - One Radio™
item.description: On the night before the cross, Jesus does something unexpected.He kneels.The One who holds all authority chooses the posture of a servant. He washes the feet of His disciples—feet that would soon run, deny, and scatter.

item.title: Good Friday - One Radio™
item.description: Good Friday is heavy.The cross stands as both a place of suffering and a symbol of salvation. Jesus is beaten, mocked, and crucified. The Son of God bears the weight of sin—not His own, but ours.

item.title: Black Saturday - One Radio™
item.description: Black Saturday feels quiet… almost too quiet.Jesus is in the tomb. The disciples are grieving. Heaven seems silent.

item.title: Easter Sunday - One Radio™
item.description: The stone is rolled away.The grave is empty.Jesus is alive.Easter is not just a celebration—it is a declaration.
